noun_definition: Expense refers to a financial transaction that is being recorded manually in the New Expensify app.
App refers to the New Expensify application used for tracking expenses in the context of the issue described.
Confirmation page refers to the screen displayed after selecting a category while tracking a manual expense in the Expensify app, where the user can confirm their selection before proceeding.
Back button refers to a navigational control in the app that allows users to return to the previous screen, specifically from the confirmation page to the category list page in this context.
category page refers to the screen in the Expensify app that displays a list of expense categories after a user has categorized an expense.
